description: Retention and alteration of the Former Lotus Motor Racing Car Factory, the demolition of all other buildings and structures on site, and the construction of a mixed-use development, comprising Purpose Built Student Accommodation (PBSA) (Sui Generis), flexible industrial floorspace (Classes E(g)(iii) and B8), and a café / community use (Classes E, F1 and F2), alongside the delivery of a service road, a landscaped public square, public realm improvements and ancillary works.
site_name: Hornsey Goods Yard, Tottenham Lane, Hornsey, London, N8 9DJ
